name: Alejandro de Humboldt National Park
description: Tucked into the mountains of eastern Cuba, across Holguín and Guantánamo provinces, this national park is named for the German naturalist Alexander von Humboldt, who visited the island in 1800 and 1801. Its rugged terrain and rocks toxic to most plants have pushed species to adapt in unusual ways. The result is one of the Caribbean's richest havens for plants and animals found nowhere else.
